comparator.name: Archaeology
comparator.academicYear: 2026–2027; September2026 generic entrant first-year60 and approved elective30 verified; remaining compulsory90 unresolved
comparator.sourceNotes: Fresh adopted2026–2027 Archaeology OER (14July2026), current product/year2261, official Dutch programme overview and official September2026 replacement table inspected on9October2026. Article2.2 confirms no new-entrant specialisations; World Archaeology and Heritage and Society belong only to students who entered in or before2025–2026. Article2.9 explicitly confirms Dutch and English for the Dutch version and English for the English version: Dutch-version first semester uses both, later instruction is English with Dutch examination options; specified Dutch-context electives can be Dutch. This formal detail takes precedence over the general public page’s less precise first-year statement. Normalized languages are corrected toNLD+ENG; original NLD offering and permanent provenance are unchanged. Current twelve5-EC first-year modules total60; all positive/zero component weights checked, old1081V24Y/25Y/27Y replaced by36Y/37Y/35Y and not counted again. The current regulations specify compulsory150 and optional15–30; a30-EC minor, exchange or coherent elective pathway is expressly permitted and preserved as open space, without invented content. Self-composed/external electives require applicable board approval, no overlap and programme-stated coherence/level conditions (including10EC at level300 or higher for self-composed30). The supported partial reconstruction therefore totals90: first-year60 plus genuine open30; it is not a complete180 pathway. The remaining90 compulsory EC require applicable new-cohort course weights, bounded choices and internship/thesis allocation. The currentAPI second year still contains outgoing40-EC WA/HS groups; its third-year common modules do not independently certify future new-cohort requirements. The formal OER delegates exact weights and sequence to the prospectus. No outgoing route is imported and no UCR assessment is made.
